options.name: SizeEncoding
options.summary: Gets or sets the source-size encoding. The default preserves the existing square-root radius law.

options.name: SizeDimension
options.summary: Gets independent name, number display and numeric key options for the shared source-size measurement.

options.name: MinimumRadius
options.summary: Gets or sets the non-negative minimum logical reference-circle radius in pixels. Default: six.

options.name: MaximumRadius
options.summary: Gets or sets the non-negative maximum logical reference-circle radius in pixels. Null retains the responsive family default, bounded between 14 and 32 pixels and raised to the minimum radius when necessary. The explicit maximum must be at least MinimumRadius at preparation.

options.name: MinimumValue
options.summary: Gets the explicit minimum source size. Null infers one domain from every bubble series.

options.name: MaximumValue
options.summary: Gets the explicit maximum source size. Null infers one domain from every bubble series.

options.name: Reversed
options.summary: Gets or sets whether larger source sizes map to smaller radii. Default: false.

options.name: StartMarker
options.summary: Gets the authored Start endpoint's marker overrides. The default fill remains the theme's muted foreground.

options.name: EndMarker
options.summary: Gets the authored End endpoint's marker overrides. The default fill remains the resolved series or observation paint.

options.name: StartLabel
options.summary: Gets or sets the legend name of the Start endpoint ("Before" by default). The legend names both ends (design rule 8).

options.name: EndLabel
options.summary: Gets or sets the legend name of the End endpoint ("After" by default).

options.name: LabelContent
options.summary: Gets or sets whether data labels show one combined caption or separate authored endpoint captions. Default: Combined.

options.name: EndpointLabelFormatter
options.summary: Gets or sets the optional formatter for separate Start and End captions. Null uses the chart's numeric value format.

options.name: StartLabel
options.summary: Gets independent visibility, typography and physical placement for the authored Start caption in Endpoints mode.

options.name: EndLabel
options.summary: Gets independent visibility, typography and physical placement for the authored End caption in Endpoints mode.

options.name: Orientation
options.summary: Gets or sets the value direction. Vertical is the default; horizontal uses X for values and Y for categories.

options.name: LabelContent
options.summary: Gets or sets whether labels show the legacy median heading or independently configured statistics. Default: Median.

options.name: StatisticLabelFormatter
options.summary: Gets or sets the optional formatter for Statistics captions. Null uses the chart's numeric value format.

options.name: Q1Label

options.name: MedianLabel

options.name: Q3Label

options.name: MaximumLabel
options.summary: Gets the rendered upper-whisker caption settings in Statistics mode.

options.name: FirstDayOfWeek
options.summary: Gets or sets the weekday in the top row. Weeks begin on this day. Default: Sunday.

options.name: DayNames
options.summary: Gets or sets seven non-empty weekday names indexed by DayOfWeek, Sunday first. Null uses invariant abbreviations. Both assignment and retrieval copy the names.

options.name: MonthNames
options.summary: Gets or sets twelve non-empty month names, January first. Null uses invariant abbreviations. Both assignment and retrieval copy the names.

options.name: CellSize
options.summary: Gets or sets a preferred cell size in pixels, between two and two hundred. Cells shrink to fit the plot. Null fills the plot; a preferred size takes precedence over MaximumCellSize.

options.name: MaximumCellSize
options.summary: Gets or sets the largest size, in pixels, cells grow to when filling the plot. Null leaves them unlimited.

options.name: Gap
options.summary: Gets or sets a cell gap from zero to twenty-four pixels. Null chooses 3.5 px, or 2.5 px above 32 weeks.

options.name: Orientation
options.summary: Gets or sets track direction. Horizontal increases to the right; vertical increases upward before axis reversal.

options.name: IndependentAxes
options.summary: Gets or sets whether every row uses its authored reading domain and optional local axis. False retains the shared displayed axis.

options.name: Orientation
options.summary: Gets or sets the value direction. Vertical is the default; horizontal uses X for values and Y for categories.

options.name: MissingCategoryPolicy
options.summary: Gets or sets how absent categories affect geometry. Zero preserves the existing behavior.

options.name: OutlineStroke
options.summary: Gets or sets immutable outline-stroke overrides. Null uses the series color and width; zero width hides the outline while retaining the area, markers and observations. Dedicated and mixed radial layouts share these overrides.

options.name: Form
options.summary: Gets or sets the radar form. Area preserves the default of AddRadar.

options.name: FillOpacity
options.summary: Gets or sets the Area form's fill opacity from zero through one. Null uses the theme area opacity.

options.name: CurveTension
options.summary: Gets or sets closed-curve tension from zero through one. Null or zero preserves straight edges; positive values use cyclic cubic tangents through the observations.

options.name: Form
options.summary: Gets or sets the anatomy. The default is proportional stage bars.

options.summary: Gets or sets label paint. Outlined (the default) keeps captions readable over flows with a surface-coloured text halo instead of a box; Backdrop adds a rectangular surface; Plain adds neither.

options.name: ColorScale
options.summary: Gets or sets the independent quantitative flow-color scale. Null uses the theme's sequential scale in Quantitative mode.

options.name: ColorDimension

options.name: RibbonVisibilityThreshold
options.summary: Gets or sets a non-negative paint-only minimum ribbon thickness in logical units. Zero retains all representable ribbons.

options.name: Alignment
options.summary: Gets or sets horizontal layer placement. The default is Justify; every flow remains directed to a later layer.

options.name: VerticalAlignment
options.summary: Gets or sets where each column's nodes occupy its unused vertical space. The default is Center.

options.name: NodeOrder
options.summary: Gets or sets ordering within each layer. The default is Auto; authored arrays and styling indexes stay unchanged.

options.name: Form
options.summary: Gets or sets Line (the default) or Area. Area closes each authored run with at least three vertices; shorter runs retain points and open outlines.

options.name: FillOpacity
options.summary: Gets or sets Area fill opacity from zero through one. Null uses the theme; Line rejects an authored opacity.

options.name: CurveTension
options.summary: Gets or sets cubic tension from zero through one. Null or zero preserves straight joins; tangents never cross a BreakBefore boundary.

options.name: OutlineStroke
options.summary: Gets or sets immutable outline overrides. Null retains series/theme paint; zero width hides only the outline.

options.name: ClosePath
options.summary: Gets or sets whether Line closes each authored run with at least three vertices. Default false preserves open lines; Area always closes eligible runs.

options.name: Model
options.summary: Gets or sets the fit model. Linear preserves the existing least-squares endpoint behavior.

options.name: PolynomialDegree
options.summary: Gets or sets the Polynomial model's degree, either two or three. The default is two.

options.name: Interval
options.summary: Gets or sets the optional pointwise interval. The default is None.

options.name: ConfidenceLevel
options.summary: Gets or sets the pointwise confidence level, from 0.5 through 0.999. The default is 0.95.

options.name: SampleCount
options.summary: Gets or sets uniform source-X samples, from 17 through 513. The default is 129.

options.name: ColorScale

options.name: ColorDimension

options.name: StartAngleDegrees
options.summary: Gets or sets the clockwise start in degrees; zero points right and -90 points up.

options.name: SweepAngleDegrees
options.summary: Gets or sets the clockwise circular span, greater than zero and at most 360 degrees.

options.name: NodeGapDegrees
options.summary: Gets or sets the gap in degrees after each positive node arc. Gaps must leave room inside the circular span.

options.name: NodeThicknessRatio
options.summary: Gets or sets node-arc thickness as a fraction strictly between zero and one of the outer radius.

options.name: FirstName
options.summary: Gets or sets the first observation's readout name. The default is First.

options.name: SecondName
options.summary: Gets or sets the second observation's readout name. The default is Second.

options.name: PositiveFill
options.summary: Gets or sets fill where First is greater than Second. Null inherits series or palette paint.

options.name: NegativeFill
options.summary: Gets or sets fill where First is less than Second. Null inherits explicit series paint or the next palette color.

options.name: PositiveFillOpacity
options.summary: Gets or sets the positive fill alpha multiplier from zero to one. Null inherits the area's theme opacity.

options.name: NegativeFillOpacity
options.summary: Gets or sets the negative fill alpha multiplier from zero to one. Null inherits the area's theme opacity.
